These public synthetic RAW fixtures contain no production model data.

- `two-bus.raw`: 100 MVA base, 50 MW + 20 Mvar load, series impedance 0.01 + j0.1 pu; independently checked against the analytical AC solution in engineering.test.mjs.
- `three-winding.raw`: three physical terminals, one star node, winding 2 out of service; verifies per-winding topology.

The real SAV, RAW, ZIP and native Excel references are local inputs and are excluded from Git.
